title: Can I claim 50% of my husband’s Social Security now — and switch to my higher benefit at 70?
summary: This article explores Social Security claiming strategies for married women, specifically whether they can claim spousal benefits at a reduced rate and later switch to their own higher benefit at 70. Understanding these claiming rules can significantly impact long-term retirement income.

title: My friend’s mother died. Can she stop Medicaid from taking the family home?

title: Here’s the real reason oil prices aren’t moving higher
summary: Rather than supply constraints, oil prices remain subdued due to weakening global demand for petroleum, reflecting broader concerns about economic growth and energy transition trends. This demand-side pressure represents a more fundamental challenge to the oil industry than temporary supply disruptions.
content: Oil prices are not higher largely because the world does not want as much oil as it used to — and that’s arguably the more troubling story.
